body:
Commit 73a75d1. Founder: "next episode." Introduces a new Eastwind Owl field operative (the Owl) -- deliberately a new character, not a reuse of the already-seeded Edinburgh Exchange Student. Real, deliberate restraint checked directly against README.md before writing anything: this episode does NOT touch Emily OS Tyler file or its line count -- the real rule (the file is three words, leave it alone) was already, canonically, carefully spent across real story weight (three words to four lines at Build 0006, to six across Season 11); adding a line casually here would cheapen a mechanic this show has always guarded. What the Owl brings instead, within her faction own established scope (they monitor Emily OS log activity, the same mechanism that first noticed the Build 0006 file update): the Ledger own older name, the Standing Debt, and two real prior cases of a debt negotiated rather than collected. The Man reveals a Stillness Council review of his own broken protocol from E3. Tyler receives the season own title as a real diegetic object -- a fading card reading UNDOCUMENTED. Writer Room Rule 1 checked: compliant. EPISODES.md/activity.md/CHANGELOG.md updated.

⚓ ☃
title: NEVER_LAND E4 'Undocumented' written — new Eastwind Owl operative, Tyler-file line count deliberately left untouched
